pages.text: Start with these goals rather than trying to craft the most impressive machine in JEI:

- Establish food you can replace reliably. - Gather the materials for the basic tools in Getting Started. - Learn to recognize and record useful ore deposits. - Set up your first Tinkers tools and a way to repair them. - Begin preparing copper, tin and bronze for steam industry. - Explore Create’s basic components and processing options.
These projects support one another. A better tool makes gathering easier; a stable food supply lets you stay out longer; a small processing workshop makes the next machine less expensive to build.
